svg.text: BricoHams | Componentes
multimode-013
PICTOGRAMA NO A ESCALA
External ECO-WORTHY LiFePO4 12 V 30 Ah battery reference
plus compatible charger and leads
Referencia: MMA-013
Cantidad de la fila: 1 set
User-supplied variant 40308275183822, SKU
DE-L13060202003-1 (1 Pack/battery only): vendor page
M5 terminals, 14.6 V max charge, 10 V discharge cutoff
and 30 A max charge/discharge. Product text mass is 3.55
kg but variant shipping-weight metadata is 0; weigh
delivered unit. 12.8 x 30 = 384 Wh conflicts with listed
360 Wh; use 360 Wh for label-reference arithmetic only.
Exact BMS model/rating/thresholds and supporting
model-specific datasheet remain unverified. Product
family page mentions internal BMS; separate 5 A charger
option is a distinct variant, not included/approved
charger. 12 V x 30 Ah = 360 Wh and 180 W ideal average
for 2 h are calculations, not usable energy or autonomy
validation
REFERENCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED
PROTOTIPO / NO FABRICAR NI CABLEAR DESDE ESTA FICHA
Anatol EA5KAO · Diego EA5JEF · Pedro Roca Molina | bricohams.org
